entities.name: DXR/IspC
observations: The 413-residue query is an exact sequence match to curated Mycobacterium bovis 1-deoxy-D-xylulose-5-phosphate reductoisomerase P64013.
Catalyzes the NADPH-dependent rearrangement and reduction of 1-deoxy-D-xylulose-5-phosphate to 2-C-methyl-D-erythritol 4-phosphate.
Predicted molecular mass is 42.85 kDa and theoretical pI is 5.44.
Pfam domains match DXP_reductoisom, DXP_redisom_C, and DXPR_C across the protein.

entities.name: DXP to MEP reaction
observations: DXP + NADPH + H+ is converted to MEP + NADP+; annotated as EC 1.1.1.267 and Rhea RHEA:13717.

entities.name: MEP isoprenoid pathway
observations: DXR/IspC performs step 1 of 6 in the methylerythritol 4-phosphate pathway for isopentenyl diphosphate biosynthesis.

entities.name: DXR cofactors
observations: The enzyme is annotated to bind NADPH and divalent metal ions, specifically Mg2+ or Mn2+.
